shared_rule: One web app, three panes. All three subscribe to GET /api/events. Alerts are red paint on the database pane, not a fourth service.

panes.name: Voice processing
panes.demo_role: see the agent hear and ask
panes.looks_like: A vertical transcript. Left: worker utterance, then parsed slots appearing one by one. Right: agent clarification question. Optional later: play TTS. Until the voice loop exists, feeding EVT-001.json is enough to animate this pane.

panes.name: Database + alerts
panes.demo_role: see the object land, then go red if invalid
panes.looks_like: A live collection view of orders. New rows slide in on order_upserted. The three-way match strip opens on click. Rows with status=flagged or an open alert render red. Supervisor can press Flag, which POSTs /orders/:id/flag — that is the website marking invalid. Do not build a second alert UI.

panes.name: Forensic search
panes.demo_role: agent finds where the mistake started
panes.looks_like: A search box. Query example: 'where did the romaine count go wrong?'. Steps stream in as investigation_step. Each step cites an order, a voice event, or a paper. Verdict is a short paragraph with citation chips that jump to the database pane.
